subject: Post-call: CarePay model-fit recommendations, benchmarks & emergency pin/rollback plan
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@carepay.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 14:07:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap & next steps — model-fit checks and emergency pin options

Alex — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and recommended next steps so we keep momentum: 

- What we heard: production integration for claims summarization is live in beta; you saw a quality dip starting last Thursday after a Redwood model refresh (shorter summaries, missing fields). Latency targets: p95 < 350ms. Token budget is tight — cost sensitivity noted.

- Immediate asks from CarePay: 1) confirmation on whether the recent model update could be pinned or rolled back quickly; 2) a targeted eval pack (we discussed a focused prompt set covering exceptions/PHI redaction) so your engineers can validate fixes; 3) an estimate for latency/cost impact if we switch to a quantized variant.

What we'll do from Redwood: 
- Ship an eval pack with recommended prompts, sample expected outputs, and benchmark artifacts (attached: carepay_eval_prompts.csv + redwood_eval_pack_v2.zip).
- Recommend two candidate models: rwd-3.8-large (current—updated last week) and rwd-3.7-stable (prior version). Also include a quantized rwd-3.8-q4 to test cost/latency tradeoffs.
- Run a quick diff on your failing prompt set (we requested a small sample from you) and propose a pin to rwd-3.7-stable if regression is reproduced. Pin action would be reversible and we can coordinate a rollback window with a 30-minute SLA for the change.

Immediate ask for you: please send 10–20 representative prompts (we discussed a small anonymized set) and confirm whether procurement should be looped now. You can reply with a shared Drive link or attach in email.

I propose we schedule a 30-minute follow-up tomorrow to review the eval results and decide on pin vs. incremental model tweaks. Are you available 10:00 – 11:00 PT?

Thanks — Rishi
--
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

Attachments: carepay_eval_prompts.csv, redwood_eval_pack_v2.zip

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@carepay.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps — model-fit checks and emergency pin options

Adding recommended test matrix and quick engineering notes so we can move fast.

Quick model recommendations (prioritized):
1) rwd-3.7-stable — baseline: known-good outputs from last validated release. Lowest risk for rollback/pin.
2) rwd-3.8-large — current default; improved general coverage but we should validate for your edge-case extraction.
3) rwd-3.8-q4 — quantized variant: ~25% token-cost savings, expected +10–25ms latency per request but still within p95 target for short prompts.

Suggested bench and prompt set (included in attached zip):
- 20 edge-case prompts (PHI-style masking, nested lists, long claim notes) — carepay_eval_prompts.csv
- Acceptance criteria: entity recall >= 94%, missing-field rate < 3%, summary brevity within 60–80 tokens for summaries.
- Perf checks: p50/p95 token latency (we auto-collect); peak concurrency simulation at 10 qps.

Engineering guardrails:
- If diff shows >6% regression in acceptance metrics compared to rwd-3.7-stable, recommend pin to rwd-3.7-stable while we iterate.
- Emergency pin process: AE approves → Infra does a pin to specific model commit hash (takes ~10–30 min to propagate) → we run smoke tests.

I attached a quick latency snapshot from our lab run (token_latency_snapshot.png) and the eval pack. Happy to own running an initial pass if Alex shares the sample prompts.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@carepay.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@carepay.ai>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 08:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps — model-fit checks and emergency pin options

Rishi / Marissa — thanks for the clear plan. We can confirm the regression aligns with the Thursday update. I've attached a sanitized sample (see link) that demonstrates missing fields in the summaries. Procurement is CC'd — they asked for (1) any cost delta if we pin to rwd-3.7-stable and (2) the rollback SLA and timeline.

We want the following: please try a pin to rwd-3.7-stable in your staging first and share the smoke test outputs. If the fix looks good, we'll coordinate a short maintenance window to pin production. Also want the eval artifacts by EOD.

I shared a GDrive link to the sample prompts: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1CarePaySample -> note: contains 12 anonymized cases.

—Alex Johnson
Head of Integrations, CarePay
alex.johnson@carepay.ai

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@carepay.ai>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 09:32:00 -0700
Subject: URGENT: CarePay — emergency pin request + rollback play (CP-2027-007)

Ben — can you please prioritize an emergency pin to rwd-3.7-stable for CarePay in staging ASAP (reference commit hash: r3.7-20270428-hashA1)? Details below:

Why: CarePay reported a reproducible regression after last week's update; they provided 12 sanitized prompts (drive link above). Marissa ran a local diff and observed ~8.2% drop vs rwd-3.7-stable (beyond our 6% threshold).

What I need from Infra: 
- Stage pin in staging within 1 hour and run our smoke harness (we'll feed the 12 prompts; Marissa to execute).
- If smoke passes, coordinate a production pin during a 30-minute maintenance window tomorrow 10:00–10:30 PT (or earlier if Ops prefers).
- Provide rollback instructions: keep previous model commit on standby; if post-pin production regressions are observed, revert to r3.7-20270428-hashA1 within 30 minutes.

Please confirm ETA and any blockers. I'll own comms with CarePay and procurement for approvals.

Thanks — Rishi
--
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
